scope: Tracked paths containing cosmet, barber, business, retail, or bridal. Reference scan covers all tracked files. This is a dependency/lifecycle cleanup, not certification of every instructional line.

disposition_codes.0: Remove: hard-coded retired course; absent from canonical/legacy courses and checked job/build tables; no outside executable callers
disposition_codes.1: Retain: application, curriculum, or registered authoring source; no proof of obsolescence
disposition_codes.2: Retain: documentation, operational evidence, or authored reference material
disposition_codes.3: Retain: operational/authoring entrypoint; no proof of obsolescence
disposition_codes.4: Retain: publicly addressable asset; may be referenced dynamically or by persisted learner content
disposition_codes.6: Retain: schema/migration or database contract history

validation.bridal: No separately named bridal repository path found; cosmetology content preserved.
